run_main: run the main function to evaluate a trained KUKA grasping policy in a PyBullet Gym environment
create_KukaGymEnv: create a KukaGymEnv instance with rendering enabled and discrete action space for the KUKA robot
load_deepq_model: load a trained DeepQ policy model from a pickle file using deepq.load for inference
step_env_episode: step through a KukaGymEnv episode using env.step with actions from the loaded policy
render_env: render the KUKA robot environment state visually during each step of the evaluation loop
